title: Verify Navigation to Insights View for Functional Tests
description: Test the navigation flow to access the Insights view specifically for functional test results
testDescription: This test verifies that users can successfully navigate to the Insights view for functional test results from various entry points in the application
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Functional test execution has been completed
3. Playwright test environment is properly configured
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the main dashboard
2. Click on 'Test Results' or equivalent navigation element
3. Select 'Functional Tests' category
4. Click on 'Insights View' option or tab
expectedResult:
1. Insights view for functional tests is displayed
2. The page title indicates 'Functional Test Insights'
3. Navigation breadcrumbs show the correct path
4. The URL contains the appropriate route parameter for functional test insights
automationNotes: Use Playwright's page.goto() and expect() methods to verify navigation and URL correctness

title: Verify Functional Test Data Loading and Visualization in Insights View
description: Validate that functional test data is correctly loaded and visualized in the Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that functional test results data is properly loaded, processed, and visualized in various charts and graphs within the Insights view
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Functional test execution with valid results data exists
3. User has navigated to the Functional Test Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Wait for the Insights view to fully load
2. Observe the data visualizations including charts, graphs, and statistics
3. Verify data points in visualizations match expected functional test results
4. Hover over specific data points to check tooltips and detailed information
expectedResult:
1. All charts and visualizations are properly rendered
2. Data displayed matches the expected functional test results
3. No error messages or empty states are displayed when data exists
4. Tooltips show accurate detailed information on hover
dataVerificationPoints: Test pass/fail ratios, execution time metrics, error distribution by test category, historical trends
automationNotes: Use Playwright's waitForSelector() for async loading elements and expect() for visual verification

title: Test Filter and Search Functionality in Functional Test Insights View
description: Validate that users can filter and search functional test results within the Insights view
testDescription: This test verifies the filtering and searching capabilities within the Functional Test Insights view, ensuring users can narrow down results based on various criteria
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Multiple functional test executions with varied results exist
3. User has navigated to the Functional Test Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Identify and click on filter controls in the Insights view
2. Apply filters for specific test status (passed, failed, skipped)
3. Apply date range filters for test execution timeframe
4. Enter search terms in the search field
5. Apply multiple filters in combination
6. Clear all filters
expectedResult:
1. Visualizations update dynamically when filters are applied
2. Only functional test results matching filter criteria are displayed
3. Search functionality returns relevant results based on search terms
4. Filter combinations work correctly to narrow down results
5. Clearing filters restores the original complete data set
filterCategories: Test status, execution date, test suite, test category, execution environment, test duration
automationNotes: Use Playwright's fill(), click(), and waitForResponse() methods to interact with and verify filter functionality

title: Verify Cross-Navigation Between Different Test Type Insights Views
description: Test the ability to navigate between Insights views for different test types (Unit, Integration, API, and Functional)
testDescription: This test ensures that users can seamlessly navigate between different test type Insights views while maintaining proper state management and data context
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Test results exist for all test types (Unit, Integration, API, and Functional)
3. User has navigated to any test type's Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. From Functional Test Insights view, identify navigation controls for switching test types
2. Navigate to Unit Test Insights view
3. Verify Unit Test data is displayed correctly
4. Navigate to Integration Test Insights view
5. Verify Integration Test data is displayed correctly
6. Navigate to API Test Insights view
7. Verify API Test data is displayed correctly
8. Return to Functional Test Insights view
expectedResult:
1. Navigation between different test type Insights views works correctly
2. Appropriate data is loaded when switching between views
3. Any applied filters or settings are properly handled during navigation
4. No errors occur during the state transitions
5. The URL updates correctly to reflect the current test type view
stateManagement: Check for persistence of user preferences, filter settings, and view configurations across navigation
automationNotes: Use Playwright's page.click() for navigation elements and network request interception to verify data loading

title: Test Export and Sharing Functionality for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify the ability to export and share functional test insights data in various formats
testDescription: This test validates that users can export functional test insights data in different formats and share reports with other users
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application with appropriate permissions
2. Functional test results with significant data points exist
3. User has navigated to the Functional Test Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Locate export controls within the Functional Test Insights view
2. Export data in CSV format
3. Export data in PDF format
4. Export data in JSON format (if available)
5. Use sharing functionality to generate a shareable link
6. Access the shared link in a different browser session
expectedResult:
1. Export functionality generates files in all supported formats
2. Exported data accurately represents what is displayed in the UI
3. Exported files are properly formatted and can be opened in appropriate applications
4. Sharing functionality generates valid links
5. Shared links open the same view with identical data and filters when accessed
automationNotes: Use Playwright's download event listeners and file download capabilities to verify export functionality

title: Verify Responsive Design of Functional Test Insights View
description: Test the responsiveness of the Functional Test Insights view across different screen sizes and devices
testDescription: This test ensures that the Functional Test Insights view correctly adapts its layout and components when viewed on various screen sizes and devices
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Functional test results exist in the system
3. Playwright test environment supports device emulation
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Test Insights view
2. Resize browser window to desktop dimensions (1920x1080)
3. Verify all UI components are properly displayed
4. Resize to tablet dimensions (768x1024)
5. Verify layout adapts appropriately
6. Resize to mobile dimensions (375x667)
7. Verify mobile-optimized layout
8. Test interactive elements on each screen size
expectedResult:
1. All charts, graphs and data visualizations remain visible and usable across different screen sizes
2. UI components reflow and resize appropriately based on screen dimensions
3. No horizontal scrolling is required on standard screen sizes
4. Touch-friendly controls appear on mobile view
5. No UI components overlap or become inaccessible
automationNotes: Use Playwright's page.setViewportSize() method and device.Pixel2 emulation capability

title: Test Data Consistency Between Backend API and Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify that the data displayed in Functional Test Insights view accurately reflects the data returned by backend APIs
testDescription: This test validates the data consistency between the raw API responses and the visualized data in the Functional Test Insights view
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Functional test results exist in the system
3. Access to backend API endpoints is available
stepsToPerform:
1. Intercept API calls that provide functional test data
2. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
3. Store the raw API response data
4. Extract displayed data values from charts and statistics in the UI
5. Compare API response values with UI displayed values
6. Check calculations for derived metrics (e.g., pass percentage, average duration)
expectedResult:
1. All data points displayed in the UI match corresponding values in the API responses
2. Summary statistics are correctly calculated from raw data
3. Charts and graphs accurately represent the underlying numerical values
4. Any data transformations are applied consistently
5. No discrepancies exist between backend data and frontend visualization
dataConsistencyPoints: Test counts, pass/fail ratios, execution durations, error counts, trend calculations
automationNotes: Use Playwright's page.route() for API interception and evaluate() to extract UI data values

title: Test User Preference Persistence in Functional Test Insights View
description: Validate that user preferences and view configurations in Functional Test Insights are properly saved and restored
testDescription: This test ensures that when users customize their Functional Test Insights view, these preferences are properly persisted across sessions
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Functional test results exist in the system
3. The Insights view supports user preference settings
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Change display settings (e.g., chart types, metrics shown)
3. Apply custom filters to the data
4. Change the time range for displayed results
5. Log out of the application
6. Log back in and return to Functional Test Insights
7. Navigate away from Insights view and back again
expectedResult:
1. All user preference settings are preserved after logout and login
2. Custom filters remain applied when returning to the view
3. Selected time ranges persist across sessions
4. Chart preferences and display options remain as configured
5. The view is restored exactly as the user last configured it
userPreferenceTypes: Chart types, visible metrics, time ranges, default filters, sorting preferences, display density
automationNotes: Use Playwright's localStorage and sessionStorage access to verify persistence mechanisms

title: Test Error Handling for Functional Test Insights with Empty or Invalid Data
description: Verify appropriate error handling and fallback UI states in Functional Test Insights when no data is available or data is invalid
testDescription: This test validates the error handling mechanisms and user experience when the Functional Test Insights view encounters empty data sets, API errors, or invalid data formats
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Test environment allows manipulation of API responses or data availability
stepsToPerform:
1. Configure test environment to return empty data sets
2. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
3. Observe UI behavior with no data
4. Configure test environment to simulate API errors
5. Refresh the Insights view
6. Configure test environment to return malformed/invalid data
7. Refresh the Insights view again
expectedResult:
1. Appropriate 'No data available' messages are displayed when data is empty
2. User-friendly error messages appear when API errors occur
3. UI does not crash or show blank screens with invalid data
4. Retry mechanisms are available for failed data loads
5. Partial data loads are handled gracefully
6. Error states provide actionable information for users
errorStateScenarios: Empty data sets, network failures, server errors, malformed data responses, timeout conditions
automationNotes: Use Playwright's page.route() to mock different API response scenarios with various error conditions

title: Test Accessibility Compliance of Functional Test Insights View
description: Validate that the Functional Test Insights view meets accessibility standards and is usable with assistive technologies
testDescription: This test ensures that the Functional Test Insights view complies with accessibility guidelines (WCAG) and is operable with keyboard navigation and screen readers
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Functional test results exist in the system
3. Playwright accessibility testing tools are configured
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Test Insights view
2. Run automated accessibility audit
3. Test keyboard navigation through all interactive elements
4. Verify focus indicators are visible on interactive elements
5. Check color contrast ratios for all text elements
6. Verify all images have appropriate alt text
7. Test screen reader announcements for dynamic content
8. Verify ARIA attributes on custom UI components
expectedResult:
1. No critical accessibility violations are detected by automated tools
2. All interactive elements are reachable and operable via keyboard
3. Color contrast meets WCAG AA standards
4. Screen readers can interpret all important information
5. Focus order is logical and follows visual layout
6. ARIA roles and attributes are correctly implemented
7. Dynamic content changes are announced to screen readers
automationNotes: Use Playwright's accessibility testing capabilities and axe-core integration for automated audits

title: Verify Dark Mode Support in Functional Test Insights View
description: Test that the Functional Test Insights view correctly renders in dark mode with appropriate contrast and readability
testDescription: This test validates that the Functional Test Insights view properly supports dark mode theme settings, ensuring all UI elements maintain proper contrast and visibility
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Functional test results exist in the system
3. Application supports theme switching functionality
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Test Insights view
2. Verify the current theme (light or dark)
3. Switch to dark mode if not already active
4. Check all charts, graphs and text elements for proper contrast
5. Verify color-coded indicators (passed/failed/skipped) are distinguishable
6. Switch back to light mode
7. Verify the transition and rendering in light mode
expectedResult:
1. All UI components adjust colors appropriately in dark mode
2. Text remains readable with sufficient contrast against backgrounds
3. Charts and graphs maintain clear visual distinction between elements
4. Color indicators for test status remain distinguishable
5. No hardcoded color values override theme settings
6. Theme preference is persisted across page navigations
themeSupportPoints: Text contrast, chart element visibility, color-coding clarity, UI component borders, icon visibility
automationNotes: Use Playwright's getComputedStyle() to verify color values and contrast ratios in different themes

title: Test Custom Dashboard Creation for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify users can create and save custom dashboards with selected Functional Test Insights visualizations
testDescription: This test validates the functionality that allows users to create personalized dashboards by selecting specific functional test metrics and visualizations they want to monitor
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application with dashboard creation permissions
2. Functional test results exist in the system
3. Custom dashboard feature is enabled
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate and click 'Create Custom Dashboard' option
3. Select multiple visualization widgets to include
4. Configure each widget with specific metrics and filters
5. Arrange widgets in the desired layout
6. Save the custom dashboard with a unique name
7. Navigate away and return to verify dashboard persistence
8. Edit the dashboard to add/remove widgets
9. Save changes and verify updates
expectedResult:
1. Custom dashboard creation interface is accessible
2. Available widgets for functional test metrics can be selected
3. Each widget can be configured with specific data points
4. Layout customization works as expected
5. Dashboard saves successfully and persists across sessions
6. Editing functionality allows modification of existing dashboards
7. Real-time data updates correctly in custom dashboards
customizationOptions: Widget selection, metric configuration, layout arrangement, color scheme selection, refresh interval settings
automationNotes: Use Playwright's drag-and-drop capabilities to test widget arrangement and configuration panel interactions

title: Test Historical Trend Analysis in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify the historical trend visualization and analysis features for functional test results over time
testDescription: This test validates that the Functional Test Insights view correctly displays and calculates historical trends in functional test performance over defined time periods
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Functional test results from multiple time periods exist in the system
3. At least 30 days of historical test data is available
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate trend analysis section or activate trend view
3. Set time period to 'Last 7 days' and verify trend display
4. Change to 'Last 30 days' and verify data updates
5. Change to 'Last quarter' and verify longer-term trends
6. Select specific metrics to trend (pass rate, execution time, etc.)
7. Apply filters to focus trend on specific test suites
8. Test trend comparison between two time periods
expectedResult:
1. Historical trends are accurately calculated and displayed
2. Time period selectors modify the data range correctly
3. Trend lines show correct direction based on underlying data
4. Statistical significance indicators are shown where applicable
5. Comparative trends display clear visual distinction
6. Data point tooltips show precise values on hover
7. Trend anomalies are highlighted appropriately
trendMetrics: Pass/fail rate trends, execution time trends, error type distribution over time, test stability trends, regression detection
automationNotes: Use Playwright to capture trend chart data points and verify calculations match expected values based on known test history

title: Test Real-Time Updates in Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify that the Functional Test Insights view updates in real-time when new test results are available
testDescription: This test validates that the Functional Test Insights view automatically refreshes or provides update notifications when new functional test results become available in the system
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Initial functional test results are displayed in Insights view
3. Ability to trigger new test runs during test execution
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view and note current data
2. In another browser tab, trigger a new functional test execution
3. Wait for test execution to complete
4. Return to Insights view tab and observe for automatic updates
5. If no automatic update occurs, check for update notification
6. Click refresh/update button if available
7. Verify data freshness indicators show recent update time
8. Enable auto-refresh setting if available and verify periodic updates
expectedResult:
1. Insights view shows notification when new data is available
2. Manual refresh button updates the view with latest data
3. Auto-refresh setting (if available) periodically updates the view
4. Data freshness indicators show correct last-updated timestamp
5. New test results are correctly incorporated into visualizations
6. Real-time updates don't disrupt user interactions in progress
7. Update mechanism works across all supported browsers
updateMechanisms: Push notifications, polling updates, manual refresh, auto-refresh settings, data freshness indicators
automationNotes: Use Playwright's multiple page contexts to simulate test execution in one context while monitoring Insights view in another

title: Test Drill-Down Capabilities in Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify that users can drill down from summary metrics to detailed test results in the Functional Test Insights view
testDescription: This test validates the ability to navigate from high-level summary visualizations to detailed individual test results through interactive drill-down functionality
prerequisites:
1. User is logged into the application
2. Functional test results with hierarchical data structure exist
3. User has navigated to the Functional Test Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Identify a summary visualization showing aggregated metrics (e.g., pass/fail chart)
2. Click on a specific segment (e.g., failed tests section)
3. Verify transition to more detailed view of that segment
4. Select a specific category or group in the detailed view
5. Drill down to individual test case results
6. Verify test case details page with full information
7. Navigate back up to summary views
8. Try different drill-down paths through various metrics
expectedResult:
1. Clicking on visualization segments transitions to appropriate detailed view
2. Each level of drill-down shows contextually relevant information
3. Navigation breadcrumbs show current position in drill-down hierarchy
4. Individual test details show complete information including logs and screenshots
5. Navigation back up the hierarchy works correctly
6. Context is maintained when drilling down and navigating back
7. Multiple drill-down paths work correctly for different metrics
drillDownLevels: Summary metrics, test categories, test suites, test cases, test steps, error details, screenshots, logs
automationNotes: Use Playwright's click() and navigation tracking to verify drill-down paths and data consistency between levels
